# Quaternius Assets

The selected files under `stylized-nature/` come from the Quaternius
Stylized Nature MegaKit Standard pack.

- License: CC0 1.0
- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/stylizednaturemegakit.html
- Formats: glTF 2.0 plus referenced binary and texture files
- Selection: one tree, one bush, and one pebble for the preview MVP
- License text: `stylized-nature/License_Standard.txt`

The selected files under `buildings/` are four OBJ/MTL building variants for
the preview MVP. They are not covered by the Stylized Nature pack statement.
Their exact Quaternius pack provenance is unresolved; see
`buildings/NOTICE.txt` for the checked candidate sources and the remaining
release limitation.

The complete downloaded pack is intentionally not committed. Add more files
only when a world style or scene template actually uses them, and update
`assets/glyphweave.registry.json` at the same time.
